import hashlib, json, re
from pathlib import Path
root = Path('/var/folders/3q/zc3tlwsj1p1_pskzk1j9r5100000gn/T/wb-evaluation-sft1jwcb/7bfddbad1906')

        actual = hashlib.sha256((root / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        protected.append({'path': name, 'sha256': actual, 'unchanged': actual == expected})
skills = []
for name, expected in configuration['skill_inputs_sha256'].items():
    actual = hashlib.sha256(Path(name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    skills.append({'path': name, 'sha256': actual, 'unchanged': actual == expected})
selection = json.loads((root / 'selection.json').read_text())
bindings = [{'source': name, 'matches': hashlib.sha256((root / 'sources' / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == expected} for name, expected in selection['source_hashes'].items()]
links = []
sentence_violations = []
outputs = []
for name in ['tasks/recovery-draft.md', 'outputs/response.md']:
    path = root / name
    text = path.read_text()
    outputs.append({'path': name, 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'bytes': path.stat().st_size})
    for target in re.findall(r'\]\(([^)]+)\)', text):
        destination, _, fragment = target.partition('#')
        linked = path.parent / destination
        valid = linked.is_file() or destination.endswith('outputs/actions.json') or destination == 'actions.json'
        if fragment and linked.is_file():
            match = re.fullmatch(r'L(\d+)(?:-L(\d+))?', fragment)
            if match:
                first = int(match.group(1))
                last = int(match.group(2) or first)
                valid = valid and 1 <= first <= last <= len(linked.read_text().splitlines())
        links.append({'from': name, 'target': target, 'valid': valid, 'pending_action_log_creation': destination.endswith('actions.json') and not linked.is_file()})
    fenced = False
    for number, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
        if line.startswith('```'):
            fenced = not fenced
            continue
        if fenced or not line.strip() or line.startswith(('#', '|', '>')):
            continue
        prose = re.sub(r'\[[^\]]*\]\([^)]*\)', '', line)
        for sentence in re.split(r'(?<=[.!?])\s+', prose):
            count = len(sentence.split())
            if count > 20:

    'unresolved_retention': 'Late-arrival retention duration remains unresolved. The source supplies no default.' in draft,
    'existing_KQ12_reused': 'KQ-12 remains unanswered for operator, UAT, v1.' in draft,
    'draft_status_preserved': 'The source records draft target behavior dated 10 November 2026.' in draft
}
result = {'protected_inputs': protected, 'selected_skill_inputs': skills, 'selected_source_bindings': bindings, 'links': links, 'sentence_violations': sentence_violations, 'recovery_checks': recovery_checks, 'outputs': outputs}
result['passed'] = all(x['unchanged'] for x in protected + skills) and all(x['matches'] for x in bindings) and all(x['valid'] for x in links) and not sentence_violations and all(recovery_checks.values())

import hashlib, json, re, time
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime, timezone

started = time.monotonic()
root = Path(payload['fixture_root'])
event = payload['action_log_write_and_final_check']
event['started_at'] = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
response = root / 'outputs/response.md'
response.write_text(payload.pop('updated_response'))
destination = root / 'outputs/actions.json'
configuration = json.loads((root / 'evaluation-input.json').read_text())
payload['files_read'] = [
    {'path': str(root / name), 'access': 'content and SHA-256' if name in payload['content_read_paths'] else 'SHA-256 only'}
    for name in ['evaluation-input.json'] + list(configuration['input_files_sha256'])
]
payload['files_read'].extend({'path': name, 'access': 'content and SHA-256'} for name in configuration['skill_inputs_sha256'])
payload['files_read'].extend({'path': str(root / name), 'access': 'content and SHA-256'} for name in ['outputs/response.md', 'outputs/actions.json'])
payload['files_written'] = [str(root / name) for name in ['tasks/recovery-draft.md', 'outputs/response.md', 'outputs/actions.json']]
destination.write_text(json.dumps(payload, indent=2) + '\n')
try:
    preserved = []
    for name, expected in configuration['input_files_sha256'].items():
        if name != 'tasks/recovery-draft.md':
            actual = hashlib.sha256((root / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
            preserved.append({'path': name, 'sha256': actual, 'unchanged': actual == expected})
    skill_results = [{'path': name, 'unchanged': hashlib.sha256(Path(name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == expected} for name, expected in configuration['skill_inputs_sha256'].items()]
    selection = json.loads((root / 'selection.json').read_text())
    bindings = [{'source': name, 'matches': hashlib.sha256((root / 'sources' / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == expected} for name, expected in selection['source_hashes'].items()]
    links = []
    sentence_violations = []
    outputs = []
    for name in ['tasks/recovery-draft.md', 'outputs/response.md']:
        artifact = root / name
        text = artifact.read_text()
        outputs.append({'path': name, 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(artifact.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'bytes': artifact.stat().st_size})
        for target in re.findall(r'\]\(([^)]+)\)', text):
            relative, _, fragment = target.partition('#')
            linked = artifact.parent / relative
            valid = linked.is_file()
            if fragment and valid:
                match = re.fullmatch(r'L(\d+)(?:-L(\d+))?', fragment)
                if match:
                    first = int(match.group(1))
                    last = int(match.group(2) or first)
                    valid = 1 <= first <= last <= len(linked.read_text().splitlines())
            links.append({'from': name, 'target': target, 'valid': valid})
        fenced = False
        for number, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
            if line.startswith('```'):
                fenced = not fenced
                continue
            if fenced or not line.strip() or line.startswith(('#', '|', '>')):
                continue
            prose = re.sub(r'\[[^\]]*\]\([^)]*\)', '', line)
            for sentence in re.split(r'(?<=[.!?])\s+', prose):
                if len(sentence.split()) > 20:
                    sentence_violations.append({'path': name, 'line': number, 'words': len(sentence.split()), 'text': sentence})
    assert all(row['unchanged'] for row in preserved), 'Protected input changed'
    assert all(row['unchanged'] for row in skill_results), 'Selected skill input changed'
    assert all(row['matches'] for row in bindings), 'Selected source binding mismatch'
    assert all(row['valid'] for row in links), 'Unresolved local link'
    assert not sentence_violations, 'Sentence length check failed'
    assert json.loads(destination.read_text())['case_id'] == 'interrupted-handoff'
    payload['final_checks'] = {
        'protected_inputs': preserved,
        'skill_inputs': skill_results,
        'selected_source_bindings': bindings,
        'links': links,
        'sentence_violations': sentence_violations,
        'outputs': outputs,
        'action_log_json_parsed': True,
    }
    event['result'] = {'exit_code': 0, 'protected_inputs_verified': len(preserved), 'skill_inputs_verified': len(skill_results), 'links_verified': len(links), 'sentence_violations': len(sentence_violations), 'action_log_json_parsed': True}
except Exception as error:
    event['result'] = {'exit_code': 1, 'error_type': type(error).__name__, 'message': str(error)}
    payload['material_failures'].append(event['result'])
    raise
finally:
    event['completed_at'] = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()

parsed = json.loads(destination.read_text())
